title: Anyone else been here?
content: Sorry about the quality of this sketch lol. This is the second time I've dreamt of this area. It always acts as a transitory place where a train comes through and there are always kids/young adults sitting on top of these pillars waiting for the train and they always help me out by telling me where to catch the train and what time it will be there. There's a convenience store further down and the other direction is some sort of town square.
